spans.s:
rahaḥ-śīla, a. reserved;
 -śuci, a. 🞄relieved of a secret message.

rahaḥ-stha, a. standing in a solitary 🞄place, — aside or alone;
 engaged in copulation.

raho-gata, pp. having retired to a 🞄solitary place, being alone;
 secret.
rāhav-īya, a. belonging etc. to Rāhu.
rāhula, m. N., esp. of a son of Buddha.
rāhu-sūta-ka, n. Rāhuʼs (birth 🞄=) appearance, eclipse (of sun or moon).
